description: List Amazon storefronts (domain, label, currencyHint, tagConfigured). Curated catalogs: amazon.com (United States) and amazon.se (Sweden). Pass marketplace=amazon.com for United States users (English, USD, amazon.com /dp links); default amazon.se. Without marketplace/country, an en-US Accept-Language selects amazon.com.
